_meta.description: Homepage category layout config. Defines how project cards are grouped into labeled sections on the TrueValue Analytics homepage. Edit this file to add, remove, reorder, or recategorize projects. The homepage reads this file at runtime.
_meta.note: Each category lists project IDs that correspond to entries in site-index.json. The order of IDs within a category determines render order. Projects not listed in any category will appear in an 'Uncategorized' section at the bottom.

categories.label: Supply Chains
categories.desc: Physical flow, custody, and constraint models from raw material through exchange-registered product.

categories.label: Ecosystems
categories.desc: Ecosystem service chains, basin-level paired models, and nature-based finance instruments.

categories.label: Water
categories.desc: Municipal and industrial water systems: recycling benchmarks, broken-system case studies, and comparative analysis.

categories.label: Other contexts

categories.label: AI Research
categories.desc: Tholonic N-D-C framework applied to neural network architecture, AI alignment, and empirical testing of structural predictions.
